_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Law extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. court_backlog) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. JUDICIAL_CRISIS) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js pattern). In Law the CONDITION-CODES (court_backlog, agency_capture...) never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger; this table bridges them. NOTE: like Finance, Law activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so active diagnosis ids already self-match; the condition-code map is the part that is strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(law-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L130-160)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L40-86 / L170-173)--> diagnosis id --(law.json issues[]._authored circuit)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition emitting a requiredFamily of a diagnosis is folded even when the condition string is not that diagnosis primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation (annotated 'requiredFamily:' only) — this replicates the code, which validates on family match. Bias is against over-marking only where NO family matches.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from law.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: SIMILAR method, LAW-SPECIFIC differences. (1) Like Finance, Law inlines condition classification and its condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens; and Law activation.diagnosticTriggers are DIAGNOSIS IDs (so the diagnoses map is largely redundant for direct self-matching, but protects co-circuit nodes). (2) Law's shared evidence families cause HEAVY cross-folding: judicial_event is a requiredFamily of BOTH JUDICIAL_CRISIS and CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION, and enforcement_event of BOTH REGULATORY_CAPTURE and MASS_INCARCERATION, so single conditions (e.g. court_backlog, agency_capture) legitimately fold to two diagnoses under the code gate. (3) Law has THREE unmapped dead-end condition-codes (macro_shock->macro_event, law_high_stress->structural_event, structural_stress->structural_event) — none of these families appears in any contract requiredFamilies. Unlike Finance's _stress_ tokens (which emitted NO family), Law's stress tokens DO emit a real family (structural_event) but it is still consumed by no contract. (4) The one catch-all-eligible diagnosis MASS_INCARCERATION (catchAllBlocked:false) is NOT fed by any stress condition-code (structural_event is not in its requiredFamilies), so no alias is grounded through the catch-all — same shape as Finance SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION. (5) Orphan count: Finance 3, Law 2 (TPJ, HIPP).

conditionCodes.reason: law-pulse-engine.js classifies macro_shock -> evidence family [macro_event] (L158), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists macro_event in requiredFamilies. The family is a dead-end: it reaches no diagnosis, hence no _authored circuit, hence no activation. No grounded alias. (Same dead-end as Finance macro_shock.)

law-pulse-engine.js classifies law_high_stress -> evidence family [structural_event] (L159), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists structural_event in requiredFamilies. It is a stress catch-all token that emits a real family which no contract consumes -> dead-end, no grounded condition->diagnosis link. The one catch-all-eligible diagnosis (MASS_INCARCERATION, catchAllBlocked:false) is reached by a diagnosis being externally marked active without evidence, NOT by this condition-code, so no alias can be grounded here.

Same as law_high_stress: classified to structural_event (L159), a family named in no contract requiredFamilies -> dead-end. No defensible condition->diagnosis link. (Contrast Finance, whose _stress_* tokens emitted NO family at all; Law's stress tokens emit structural_event but it is still unconsumed.)

activationsWithTriggersButNoTriggerSourc.reason: Activation has diagnosticTriggers but its brainNodeId appears in NO issue._authored (or canonical) circuit, and no condition-code chain reaches it (no issue circuit contains TPJ). Under current wiring nothing marks it active, so extinction would ALWAYS list it for retirement. No grounded alias exists; NOT fabricated. Needs authoring into an issue circuit (Civil Law / perspective-taking is a plausible JUDICIAL_CRISIS or CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION member) before extinction should touch it. (Law analog of the Finance orphan activations; Law has TWO.)
